selected_records.title: TRACE: A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems

article.body:
TRACE proposes a measure for explainability debt in production AI

An arXiv listing dated 7 October 2026 identifies TRACE as “A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems.” The available record provides no abstract or supporting evidence describing the framework’s methods, use in a factory or infrastructure system, or results.

No facility, production process, output capacity or physical constraint is specified. The record also identifies no users, suppliers or supply-chain effects, so it does not establish a production deployment or operational impact.
